sn56.3:1.1: hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajiṃsu || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || || Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjissanti || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || || Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjanti || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya ||
sn56.3:2.1: Katamesaṃ catunnam || || Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || Dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa || || Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajiṃsu || pabbajissanti || pabbajanti || sabbe te imesaṃ yeva catunnam ariyasaccānam yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || ||
sn56.3:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhanti || pe || yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || || Ye
